items.title: 15.9 Diagnostic tests for nervous disorders (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu introduction to diagnostic tests (PDF 51-52).

blocks.text: Nervous system ki bimariyon ki pehchan (diagnosis) ke liye kai tests banaye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt: Agle teen topics ke tests mein se kaun sa test tasveer banane ke bajaye dimagh ki barqi sargarmi record karta hai?
blocks.explanation: EEG (electroencephalography). CT aur MRI andar ki tasveerein banate hain.

items: Asabi bimariyon ki pehchan ke tests: EEG, CT scan aur MRI (agle topics).
